In your opinion, do you think there is a difference between what the original myth was? It's hard for us to say. The process begins with all gods being asexual; they are either nonsexual or both male and female. This is because in all traditions, the god must represent a balance of forces—male and female. Over time, certain characteristics will change to reflect better the societal hierarchy.

So, maybe in the beginning when females were in charge, Pangu was a female character but over time it was changed to a male character. It's almost impossible for us to go back and rebuild or reimagine what it was like originally. 

Next class, we'll discuss the steps people—specifically those involved in agriculture—in early civilizations. Remember that throughout most of human history, major conquerors came from these steps. We will be discussing them next class.
